text:
Sofia: Quick sync 1 AtlasPay wants a drop-in replacement for CompetitorX for their payments chat. Must match response shape (no streaming), prompt parity, and clear cost delta. They attached a security questionnaire.

Ravi: Plan: (1) compat shim to translate request/response fields, (2) canonical prompt set + mapping rules, (3) pricing worksheet comparing hosted vs 3-month Dedicated commit.

Liam: Engineering note: client expects a single final payload. We can add a single-chunk runtime toggle. Also watch header names and session ids.

Nina: Security: AtlasPay needs SOC2 proof, a vuln disclosure policy, customer-managed KMS, and IP allowlisting for the POC. Uploaded questionnaire to Legal and pinged Infra.

Ravi: @Liam estimate for shim + single-chunk + mapping + perf note? Need RAG estimate today.

Liam: Rough: shim+middleware 2 dev-days, single-chunk toggle 1 day, tests+infra 1 day. Perf hit ~5-10% CPU, tail +20-50ms depending on output length.

Sofia: They want sample bill for 1M tokens/mo and a Dedicated scenario. Also want cost delta vs CompetitorX.

Ravi: I'll draft a two-sheet calc and recommend a small POC credit. Suggest canary routing: start at 10% traffic.

Nina: On data retention: default metrics retained, transcripts can be disabled. For POC we can enable no-logging mode but need infra sign-off to exclude backups.

deploy-bot: branch created: atlaspay-compat-330000 (CI: passing).

Sofia: Next steps: Ravi to share pricing worksheet + parity plan by EOD tomorrow. Liam to prototype single-chunk toggle and mapping example. Nina to flag legal/security blockers. I'll schedule tech deep-dive Fri 10am PT.

Ravi: For parity tests propose 50 seed prompts covering payments, disputes, refunds. If divergence > threshold, enable targeted fallthrough to CompetitorX for problem prompts.

Liam: I'll open a demo PR for mapping + single-chunk flag by EOD.

Sofia: Thanks team 1 I'll share this thread with AtlasPay as prep. :thumbsup:
